artworks.title: On Board of the Stony Brook Packet
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a serene scene with sailboats on a calm body of water. The perspective is low, showing a horizon with sailboats spread across it. The sketch is delicate with finely penciled lines. The color palette is muted, mainly light beige and gray. The water closest to us has a subtle texture with faint ripples. In the distance, sailboats suggest a distant shore or harbor. Handwritten notes on the lower edge add authenticity to the image.

artworks.title: Nelson Mathewson
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man from the waist up, facing forward. He has a full, oval face with dark eyes and a slight smile. His hair is wavy, parted on the side, and framing his face with curls. He is dressed in a jacket, waistcoat, high-collared shirt, and a cravat or bow tie. The background is plain, focusing on the subject. The artist's signature and the year 1839 are visible below the portrait.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person, positioned facing the viewer. The person's features are depicted in a stylized, somewhat abstract manner, with a focus on the eyes, nose, and mouth. The details are subdued, giving the face a contemplative appearance with slightly downturned lips and a furrowed brow. The hair is dark and appears to be medium length. The person seems to be wearing a simple garment, though details of clothing are not evident due to the indistinct shading. There are no visible accessories or objects being held. The background is a textured, dark wash with little discernible detail, emphasizing the face. The bottom left corner contains the artist's signature, "Jerome Myers" and the date "1906."

artworks.title: Archer, Nude Study
artworks.medium: charcoal and black chalk heightened with white gouache on brown wove paper

artworks.title: Signature, "TH. Nast, Oct. 17, 1901"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on back of a Union League Club card
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person from the side view, depicted in mid-air with arms outstretched in front and legs bent behind. The person has simple facial features, spiky hair, and wears a coat and pants. Swirling lines around the figure suggest motion or wind. The background is plain with a signature and date “Thu: Nast, Oct 17, 1901” written to the right of the figure.

artworks.title: Gideon Fairman
artworks.medium: charcoal, pen and brown ink, touched with white gouache, on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body in portrait format. He is facing slightly to his left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a strong jawline, deep-set eyes, and curly dark hair styled neatly. He is wearing a formal outfit with a high-collared shirt and a dark coat draped over his shoulder like a cape. The background is a plain, dark gradient with a lighter area behind his head, drawing focus to his face. No jewelry or other objects are present with the man in the portrait.

artworks.title: R. Strong
artworks.medium: graphite and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a chair, reading a book. He has short, wavy hair brushed back, and is wearing a dark jacket, a white shirt, and a cravat or necktie. The man is in profile, with his eyes closed as he reads, and the background is textured.

artworks.title: Interior, Fitzwilliam Museum
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an art gallery or museum interior displaying classical sculptures. The drawing shows an interior space filled with classical sculptures and relief panels, showcasing objects displayed on pedestals and within glass cases. The walls are adorned with carved reliefs, while the ceiling features ornate detailing reminiscent of classical architecture, supported by tall fluted columns. Light and shadows play across the surfaces, emphasizing the three-dimensional nature of the art objects. The overall atmosphere conveys admiration for classical art, capturing the grandeur and elegance of the museum or gallery setting.

artworks.title: Study of a Hand
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white chalk on green  wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a human hand resting on a flat surface with a pencil nearby. The hand is detailed with contours and skin texture, and the fingers are slightly curled. The pencil is placed parallel to the wrist. The drawing uses precise lines and gradients for a 3D effect, and the paper texture complements the lines.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with a path winding through tall trees. The dense forest fills the space without a visible horizon. The detailed brushstrokes depict textures of tree bark, foliage, and rocks. The color palette is warm and muted, with earthy tones dominating. A small stream flows over rocks in the foreground, surrounded by dense vegetation.

artworks.title: Hudson River Landing [recto]
artworks.medium: pen with gray and black ink on laid paper torn from a book
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene with a large building on the left, a sailboat anchored to the right, and another sailboat on the horizon. The illustration uses fine linework with a color palette of beige and gray. Rocks line the shore with hatching for texture, and hills are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Highlands from Newburgh [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper torn from a book
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line runs across the image and is low in the composition. It divides a range of distant hills slightly obscured by soft pencil lines. Close to us, there are gentle, curving lines suggesting a path leading toward the horizon, with a few simple structures nestled at the base of the hills. A row of slender trees partially obscures the buildings, providing a sense of scale and depth. The drawing, rendered in pencil, features faint and delicate lines with light shading to denote the terrain and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, relying solely on the pencil's shade against the creamy off-white paper, which gives it a muted and serene appearance.

artworks.title: Capilla Real Entablature, Granada
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing architectural details. The image displays intricate lines depicting an ornate architectural feature, possibly from a classic or historical building. The drawing is done in pencil and emphasizes the detailed moldings and finishes framing different sections of the architecture. The lines are precise, showcasing the elaborate construction, with a focus on ornamental carvings and structural elements like arches and cornices. The aesthetic conveys depth and craftsmanship found in historic architecture.

artworks.title: The Horse Shoe on the Shenandoah, Virginia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a landscape drawing with a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is placed near the middle of the image, marked by faint, rolling hills that stretch across the page. To the left, a large tree with sparse foliage rises above the scene, with its slender branches reaching toward the center. The brushstrokes are light and unhurried, employing simple lines to outline trees and land contours, suggesting a sketch or preparatory work. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing brown ink on a beige paper background. Close to us, more loose lines depict the uneven ground and small clusters of trees that add depth. The overall simplicity of the strokes and the limited palette evokes a calm and timeless landscape.

artworks.title: Munich Factory
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with tall, leafless trees extending across the horizon, forming a dense woodland. The horizon is toward the upper third of the image, populated by the silhouettes of trees. The drawing is done with quick, loose pencil strokes to convey the texture of the trees and branches. The color palette is monochromatic with soft greys and blacks against the warm paper tone. There is a body of water running horizontally in the foreground, reflecting parts of the scene with some marks indicating ripples. In the background, behind the trees, there are hints of structures, possibly a fence or bridge.

artworks.title: Man Seated at a Table
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a man shown from the waist up. He is seated, with his body facing slightly to the right, but his head turned towards the viewer. The man has short hair, neatly styled, with a fringe partially covering his forehead. His facial features are softly sketched, with a neutral expression. He wears a buttoned coat over a shirt, the collar of which is visible above the coat. The man's right arm rests on a surface, and he holds a slender walking cane with both hands. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figure as the central focus of the drawing.

artworks.title: Lafayette (Two Views)
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with gray and brown wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures shown from head to toe, each in a separate scene on a split canvas. On the left side, a person is positioned slightly turned with one hand raised and the other holding a stick or cane. Their face is shadowed, and they have short, dark hair. They are draped in a long cloak or coat, with an archway and a statue partially visible behind them. On the right side, another individual stands full-length in the light of an open doorway, facing forward. This character also has short hair and is wearing a similar cloak or long coat, and they appear to be holding a walking stick or similar object. The background includes suggestions of architecture and trees, all rendered in a monochromatic wash.

artworks.title: Figure Costume Study for Columbus Mural, Washington, D.C.
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing barefoot, holding a long pole with both hands. He is leaning slightly to one side and looking over his shoulder to his right. The man has a beard and receding hairline, with shoulder-length hair. He wears a tunic with puffed sleeves and a skirt-like piece. The background is plain and unadorned, with the focus solely on the individual. The drawing is in a monotone color palette, giving it an aged and classical appearance.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Seated Man
artworks.medium: black chalk on bristol board
artworks.description: An older man is depicted in a half-body portrait, seated in a chair. He is facing slightly to the side, with his right arm resting on the arm of the chair. The man has a long, narrow face with deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a small chin. His hair is thinning on top and combed back, revealing a smooth forehead. He is dressed in a formal suit with a high-collared white shirt underneath. The jacket is buttoned up neatly, and he appears to be in a relaxed, seated pose. The background is a plain, textured surface. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: charcoal and (graphite?) on tan wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person drawn from the shoulders up in profile view, with only the upper part of the body visible. The person's head is turned to the right, providing a clear side view of their facial features, which include a contemplative expression. They are wearing a tall, cylindrical top hat and a high-collared jacket or coat. The background is a plain, lightly speckled sheet of paper with visible aging and slight stains.

artworks.title: Nile Journey, Tmui of Ptolemy
artworks.medium: black crayon on green wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a rolling hillside and ruins in the distance. A rocky hill with sparse vegetation and ancient stone structures sits near the upper third of the scene. The artwork features sketchy and loose pencil marks, giving a dynamic feeling. The color palette consists of muted tones on a soft grey backdrop contrasting with darker pencil lines. The land close to us has softer shapes and lightly suggested textures, while the rocky formation in the distance is sharper and more defined.

artworks.title: George Reynolds
artworks.medium: pen and brown-black ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows the full back view of a person standing in front of an easel. The individual is in a relaxed stance, holding a brush in their right hand and painting on the canvas. Their head is slightly bent forward, and they have medium-length wavy hair. They are wearing a loose, long coat and trousers, and there is a patterned cloth on a chair nearby. The canvas on the easel displays a sketch of an elderly man's head and body. The setting features simple linework representing a wooden floor and an indistinct white background.

artworks.title: Johnson Mundy, Sculptor
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a high stool, working on a bust. He is dressed in 19th-century attire and appears to be sculpting the bust with a tool. The bust is of a woman with detailed hair and draped clothing. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Sketching - George Fuller
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a chair, facing an easel and painting. He has a full beard, mustache, curly hair, and wears a suit. He holds a palette in his left hand and a brush in his right, with a pipe in his mouth. Details include his clothing, shoes, and the minimalistic background of a wooden floor. The drawing is signed "George Fuller."
